title: 2025 上海马拉松竞赛规程
claims: The Shanghai Marathon starts on Zhongshan East 1st Road at the Bund.
The course finishes at Xujiahui Sports Park.
The route passes the Bund, Nanjing Road, Jing’an Temple and Xintiandi.
